source: NCBI PubMed exact fallback plus fail-closed replacements

rows.focus: Systematic review/meta-analysis found iron deficiency anemia can falsely elevate HbA1c and that iron therapy often lowers measured HbA1c.
rows.evidence_boundary: Assay interference varies by anemia definition and HbA1c method; changes in HbA1c do not necessarily represent changes in glycemia.

rows.focus: Randomized double-blind trial of a cholecalciferol-phosphate skin patch found it safe but did not significantly improve vitamin D status in humans.
rows.evidence_boundary: Patch formulation and exposure are specific; negative findings should not be generalized to oral vitamin D.

rows.focus: Systematic review/meta-analysis of vitamin D supplementation for bone health in non-White adults found limited evidence for meaningful BMD or fracture benefit.
rows.evidence_boundary: Trials were heterogeneous in ethnicity, dose, duration, baseline status, and co-interventions.

rows.focus: Post hoc DPVD analysis found metabolic trajectory modified lumbar-spine BMD response to eldecalcitol in adults with prediabetes.
rows.evidence_boundary: Post hoc analysis of an active vitamin D analog; not equivalent to general vitamin D supplementation.

rows.focus: Review of vitamin D3–Nrf2 signaling across oxidative, inflammatory, metabolic, hepatic, and cardiovascular disease models.
rows.evidence_boundary: Mechanistic synthesis does not establish clinical benefit from supplementation.

rows.focus: Scoping review of nutrition in pregnancy with inflammatory gut disease highlighted magnesium, folate, and B12 deficiencies but found no direct intervention studies linking supplementation to fetal outcomes.
rows.evidence_boundary: Only five studies met inclusion criteria and evidence was primarily observational.

rows.focus: Narrative review described undernutrition, anemia, overweight/obesity, food insecurity, and disruption of iron-folate programs among Indonesian youth during COVID-19.
rows.evidence_boundary: Country- and pandemic-specific narrative synthesis; not intervention efficacy evidence.

rows.focus: Review of iron, copper, zinc, and calcium homeostasis emphasized both deficiency and toxicity and the narrow therapeutic window for trace elements.
rows.evidence_boundary: Broad physiology/diagnostic review; treatment is metal- and disease-specific.

rows.focus: Phenotype-guided review of vitamin B12 deficiency and unexpectedly elevated B12 in early childhood emphasized maternal status, MMA/homocysteine, and neurologic risk.
rows.evidence_boundary: Pediatric clinical guidance; replacement route and urgency depend on phenotype and cause.

rows.focus: Small randomized double-blind crossover trial found grape-seed extract did not change post-exercise hypotension but showed exploratory favorable ambulatory BP, FMD, and exercise-BP signals.
rows.evidence_boundary: Only 10 participants; exploratory vascular findings require larger confirmation.

rows.focus: Focused review of six RCTs and four observational studies found magnesium evidence more consistent for recovery/soreness and inflammatory markers than direct ergogenic performance.
rows.evidence_boundary: Heterogeneous formulations, doses, baseline magnesium status, and populations limit conclusions.

rows.focus: Synthesis of 25 meta-analyses found flavanone intake associated with favorable cardiovascular, lipid, blood-pressure, glucose, and CRP outcomes, with heterogeneous evidence.
rows.evidence_boundary: Umbrella-style synthesis inherits limitations and heterogeneity of underlying meta-analyses.

rows.focus: Review of sex-hormone regulation of hepcidin proposed cycle-dependent iron regulation and a biomarker-timing framework.
rows.evidence_boundary: Predicted cycle-level hepcidin patterns are not consistently demonstrated; synchronized supplementation remains hypothetical.

rows.focus: Review of the FGL1-hepcidin axis linked iron homeostasis with hypoxia, inflammation, erythropoietic stress, and immune-checkpoint biology.
rows.evidence_boundary: Mechanistic/biomarker review; therapeutic applications remain investigational.

rows.focus: Repeated-measures crossover pilot found nitrate- and betalain-rich beetroot juices raised nitrate/nitrite and lowered systolic BP versus placebo, with formulation-dependent vascular effects.
rows.evidence_boundary: Small healthy-adult pilot; cannot establish long-term cardiometabolic benefit.

rows.focus: Mouse study found zinc deficiency worsened cisplatin kidney injury through impaired AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α adaptation, Nrf2 defenses, and increased oxidative stress/apoptosis.
rows.evidence_boundary: Animal deficiency model; does not establish zinc supplementation as nephroprotection in patients receiving cisplatin.

rows.focus: Retrospective cohort found elevated serum B12 without supplementation associated with malignancy, particularly solid tumors.
rows.evidence_boundary: Association does not establish causality; elevated B12 may reflect underlying disease, transport, liver, or renal abnormalities.

rows.focus: Biogenic selenium nanoparticles inhibited platelet activation and thrombosis in ex vivo/in vivo models while prolonging bleeding time.
rows.evidence_boundary: Nanoparticle antithrombotic platform is not equivalent to dietary selenium supplementation and bleeding liability requires definition.

rows.focus: Cross-platform study found substantial method-dependent differences in vitamin B12 reference intervals and deficiency classification, with only low-to-moderate correlation with holotranscobalamin.
rows.evidence_boundary: Analytical-platform study informs interpretation, not supplementation efficacy.

rows.focus: Review of curcumin in type 2 diabetes found mechanistic and clinical biomarker signals but emphasized modest effects, formulation heterogeneity, low bioavailability, and lack of disease-modifying outcomes.
rows.evidence_boundary: Curcumin should be considered investigational/adjunctive rather than a replacement for evidence-based diabetes care.

rows.focus: Latent-class analysis of 1,117 pernicious-anemia society respondents identified high-, moderate-, and low-burden symptom profiles independent of intrinsic-factor antibody status.
rows.evidence_boundary: Self-reported historical survey data and selection bias limit generalizability; symptom clusters do not validate treatment frequency.

rows.focus: Case report described severe isolated neuropsychiatric symptoms with profound B12 deficiency that improved after B12 replacement.
rows.evidence_boundary: Single case cannot estimate frequency or establish that B12 deficiency explains most isolated psychiatric presentations.

rows.focus: Review of tea bioactives in obesity found strongest human evidence for modest green-tea catechin/caffeine effects, while many mechanistic claims remain preclinical.
rows.evidence_boundary: Effects are modest, heterogeneous, preparation-dependent, and do not support tea as primary obesity treatment.

rows.focus: Quercetin review found modest human blood-pressure signals in metabolic syndrome but heterogeneous effects on glucose, lipids, inflammation, weight, and endothelial outcomes.
rows.evidence_boundary: Clinical evidence is formulation-, dose-, population-, and duration-dependent and remains incomplete.

rows.focus: Cross-sectional study in adults with obesity linked higher dietary polyphenol intake with depot-specific expression of PI3K/Akt/PTEN insulin-signaling genes.
rows.evidence_boundary: Cross-sectional gene-expression associations cannot establish causal metabolic benefit.

rows.focus: Systematic review of seminal-plasma metabolomics identified recurring changes in carnitine, amino acids, sugars, and fatty-acid oxidation pathways in male infertility.
rows.evidence_boundary: Biomarker/metabolomics synthesis does not establish supplement efficacy.

rows.focus: Review of Clerodendrum species summarized preclinical glucose, lipid, inflammatory, and cardiovascular signals relevant to metabolic syndrome.
rows.evidence_boundary: Human studies are sparse; efficacy and safety remain unconfirmed clinically.

rows.focus: Review of SIRT7 in hepatic metabolism, mitochondrial function, steatosis, fibrosis, and stress adaptation found evidence predominantly from cell and animal models.
rows.evidence_boundary: No selective SIRT7 activator has demonstrated clinical efficacy in liver disease.

rows.focus: Flavonoid-rich Potentilla discolor improved glucose markers, organ injury, gut microbiota, and fecal metabolites in db/db mice.
rows.evidence_boundary: Mouse/FMT/metabolomics evidence cannot establish human antidiabetic efficacy.

rows.focus: Review proposed stage-specific NAD+-SIRT3, NRF2, autophagy, and mitophagy targets for age-related hearing loss.
rows.evidence_boundary: Timing framework is translational and largely preclinical; human intervention evidence is insufficient.

rows.focus: Review of mitochondrial dysfunction in type 2 diabetes emphasized that NAD+ precursors, targeted antioxidants, and mitophagy enhancers remain investigational despite mechanistic target engagement.
rows.evidence_boundary: Dedicated mitochondrial modulators lack demonstrated glycemic or clinical benefit in adequately powered trials.

rows.focus: Review of resveratrol, quercetin, EGCG, astaxanthin, lycopene, berberine, and CoQ10 as mitochondrial-targeted phytochemicals in reproductive aging.
rows.evidence_boundary: Mechanistic and preclinical evidence is stronger than clinical evidence; large trials are needed.

rows.focus: Wogonoside improved steatohepatitis, insulin resistance, mitochondrial stress, lipid dysregulation, and ferroptosis markers in mouse and HepG2 models.
rows.evidence_boundary: Preclinical MASH evidence cannot establish clinical efficacy or dosing.

rows.focus: Review of sirtuins, NAD+ decline, and immunosenescence concluded NAD+ precursors and sirtuin activators remain promising but investigational, with little robust human outcome evidence.
rows.evidence_boundary: No established anti-aging indication; long-term safety and clinically meaningful immune endpoints remain insufficient.

rows.focus: Inflammaging review covered senolytics, NAD+ precursors, sirtuin biology, anti-inflammatory therapies, and lifestyle interventions for age-related multimorbidity.
rows.evidence_boundary: Many geroscience interventions are early-phase or investigational; biomarker changes are not proven healthspan extension.

rejected.reason: Ovarian-cancer biomarker-treatment review; micronutrient keyword/category collision.
Primary topic was HIV sleep-disorder management; iron mention was peripheral.
Multiple-myeloma ferroptosis/metabolism paper; not micronutrient supplementation evidence.
Iron used to optimize antibody-production cell culture; out of site scope.
Polymer-microbe bioelectrocatalysis paper; out of supplement/health evidence scope.
Food-frequency questionnaire validation paper; not enrichment evidence for compounds or interventions.
Ruthenium antibacterial nanostructure paper; unrelated to nutritional mitochondrial evidence.
PARP-inhibitor mitochondrial dTMP cell-biology paper; supplement keyword collision.
General REST transcription-factor review; no relevant performance/supplement exposure.
General oocyte-aging mechanism review duplicated stronger phytochemical-specific reproductive-aging coverage.
